alt: Exercise 1.3 · Q6: The sum of the ages of the father and son is 72 years. Six years ago, the father's age was 2 times the age of the son. What was son's age six years ago?

steps.title: Set up
steps.text: \[\begin{aligned}&\text{Let the son's age six years ago }=x\\[5pt]&\quad \text{years}\\[5pt]&\text{Then the father's age six years ago }=\\[5pt]&\quad 2x\text{ years}\\[5pt]&\text{Present ages: son }=x+6,\text{ father }=2x\\[5pt]&\quad +6\\[5pt]&\text{Sum of present ages }=72\\[5pt]&(x+6)+(2x+6)=72\\[5pt]&3x+12=72\\[5pt]&3x=60\\[5pt]&x=20\end{aligned}\]

steps.title: Result
steps.text: \[\begin{aligned}&\text{The son's age six years ago was }\textcolor{#047857}{\mathbf{20}}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{years}\textcolor{#047857}{\textbf{.}}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{(Check: present ages are }26\text{ and }46,\text{ sum }=72\text{ $\;\checkmark$.)}\end{aligned}\]
